note:
Malcolm, 2026-10-08, on r1: 'The explainer image should maybe show the moisture being held as a blue color - or at least have other ways to show more clearly to the viewer the working mechanism the image is conveying. Now it's not clear. Lets make a new batch.' r1 drew the block well but the film, the held water and the three sizes all read as the same cream-pink material, so nothing in the picture said 'moisture held'.

=== WHAT CHANGES IN r2 ===

1. THE WATER IS BLUE. Every droplet and the sheen of held water are a clear, pale sky-blue, glassy and translucent, the only cool colour in the picture, so the eye finds the moisture at once. Malcolm asked for blue, so the house negatives against blue are lifted for the water only; the block, the film and the background stay warm peach, blush and cream. No teal and no dark or saturated blue.
2. THE FILM IS A VISIBLY SEPARATE LAYER. The collagen film on top is a translucent, slightly glossy cream-white sheet of twisted cables lying over the skin like a thin quilt, with a clear gap of blue sheen between it and the pads, so the film is seen holding the water in.
3. THE CREAM IS SEEN BEING APPLIED (slots B and C). A smooth dollop of white cream sits on the surface at one point and spreads outward into the film, so the viewer sees where the film comes from. One dollop, no hand, no jar, no fingertip.
4. THE WATER THAT IS NOT HELD (slot C only): at the far ends of the block, beyond where the film reaches, a few small blue droplets rise from the bare surface and thin into the air, while under the film they stay. That contrast is the mechanism in one glance. It is a difference of PLACE along the block, not a before-and-after: no dividing line, no two panels, the same block throughout.

Everything else stands from r1: the registers forbid showing any material passing below the top layer (collagen is 'far too large to cross intact skin'; 'penetrates deep' is on the avoid lists), so the deep layers stay calm and untouched, with no arrows, glow or new fibres. No text, no labels, no face, no product packaging. Square 2048, class B, no references. Suppliers: seedream, nbp_pro, nbp_flash, flux2, luma (gpt-image is out of OpenAI credits today). Two candidates each. FLUX.2 prints digits on glassware: check at full size. Malcolm picks by underscore; never shortlist.

slots.title: A · The film as a separate quilt over the pads, pale-blue water held beneath it, deep layers untouched
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key, lit with soft even diffuse light. Square format. Warm generic skin tones throughout - peach, blush, cream and pale pink - on a smooth warm cream background gradient, faintly glowing. The ONLY cool colour anywhere in the picture is the pale sky-blue of the water described below.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, the cut face exactly parallel to the picture plane, edges horizontal. THE BLOCK DOES NOT TOUCH THE SIDES OF THE FRAME: it sits inset, about four fifths of the frame's width, with clear empty background to its left and right. ITS LEFT AND RIGHT ENDS ARE FULLY MODELLED AND VISIBLE, every layer finishing in a rounded three-dimensional end face, never a flat slice. It stands on a thin clear glass plate that extends a little beyond it at both ends.

THE STACK, TOP TO BOTTOM: a quilted surface of soft rounded peach pads, about a sixth of the block's height; a thin cream film of fine parallel strands; a thick band of packed rounded spheres, large and clearly separate, each a distinct glossy ball; a thin peach plate; a zone of pearl-ivory cables lying in loose horizontal waves; a second peach plate; two rows of large cream-blush lobules. The deep layers are calm, intact and untouched, all warm, with no blue anywhere in them.

ON TOP OF THE SKIN LIES THE COLLAGEN FILM: a continuous, even, translucent, slightly glossy cream-white sheet made of long thick cables, each visibly three strands twisted together, lying flat like a thin quilt laid over the pads across the whole width. The film is clearly A SEPARATE LAYER: a small, clear gap shows between its underside and the tops of the pads, and that gap is filled with a thin glassy sheen of PALE SKY-BLUE WATER. Clear pale-blue droplets in three sizes sit in that gap, caught against the underside of the film and resting in the dips between the pads, each one glassy, bright-edged and translucent so the peach pads show through it. The pads under the film are swollen, plump, taut and glossy, pressed close together with no gaps, with a crisp specular highlight along the top of the film.

Within the quilted pads only, a few short rods and tiny fragments of the same cream-white three-stranded material sit between the top pads, each fragment with one small pale-blue droplet beside it. NOTHING OF THE MATERIAL AND NO BLUE APPEARS BELOW THE QUILTED TOP LAYER.

Calm, luxurious, clinical and clean, like a frame from a premium skincare advertisement, with nothing written anywhere.
